quest.title: Good Stuff, but Terrible Taste
quest.description: Help Salsa place the object(s) in a suitable location.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Umm, {NICKNAME}, don't you think this puzzle is a little strange...

choices.text: I think it's fine as long as it gives us a treasure chest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're not wrong, but uh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon has so many questions. Who placed these items? And why did they place them here?

choices.text: Sometimes the more you think about it, the worse it makes you feel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But some questions don't go away once they pop up in your head... Every time Paimon closes her eyes, they spin around like Specters... Hmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon got it! These puzzles in the wild are actually set up by the Adventurers' Guild! The aim is to train the Guild's rookie adventurers!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After all, places like ruins and dungeons are really dangerous. Most puzzles in the wild are safer compared to those deadly devices.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As for this strange puzzle... A rookie adventurer from the Adventurers' Guild must have set it up! This person has no experience so it ended up looking pretty strange.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How's that? Makes a lot of sense, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So... it's a case of rookies training fellow rookies?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: U—Umm, that can't be helped! No one is born with work experience, so if you must have experience before you can do the job, then no one will be able to work!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon doesn't mind a strange puzzle if that's the case.
How weak! To be kind to others is to be cruel to yourself!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woah! Wh—Where did you pop up from, little girl?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Lil' Miss, I'm not some nameless little girl. Behold, standing before you is the great artist Salsa, who will be the future of Fontaine's art scene.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lil' Miss!? Is she referring to Paimon?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #{M#I don't think I will ever be addressed as "Lil' Miss."}{F#I'm a Lil' Miss, yes, but...}

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: #Well of course! Look, I'm THIS much taller than you! Although I'm shorter than the {M#Mister}{F#Miss} next to you...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: #But Mom said that as long as I drink a lot of milk and go to bed on time, I'll definitely grow taller! So I'll be a big sister in a few years' time, and you'll be a {M#younger brother}{F#younger sister}!

choices.text: I don't think it works that way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Salsa, what are you doing here? Oh! Is this canvas yours?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Yeah, the scenery's really pretty here so it's a great place to sketch. If it weren't for these ugly things, I would have completed my painting long ago.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: #{M#Mister}{F#Miss} and flying Lil' Miss, are you two here to sketch too? Excellent taste!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, we forgot to introduce ourselves... Paimon's Paimon, not some "flying Lil' Miss"! {M#He}{F#She} is {NICKNAME}, and we are adventurers traveling around the world.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Wha—! So you guys are members of that evil organization!? Oh no, I let my guard down...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Evil organization?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Didn't Lil' Miss Paimon mention it just now? Those bad guys in green from that evil organization. They installed all these ugly things here, and ruined all the beautiful scenery...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: I didn't realize you two were together with those evil green guys! What am I gonna do now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Didn't Paimon say that— Sigh, forget it. Is there anything we can do to help? After all, {NICKNAME} is a member of the Adventurers' Guild...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Ooohhh! Are you going to become one of the good guys now? That's the right choice!

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: We should work together to defeat the evil organization, so our eyes no longer get polluted by ugly things!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't understand... What do we have to do, exactly? We can't just charge into the headquarters of the Adventurers' Guild, right?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Dad said that we have to do things one step at a time. So, we should start with what's in front of us.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and Lil' Miss Paimon, please help me rearrange these ugly things!

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: With Great Artist Salsa's guidance, this is going to be a piece of cake, so don't worry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #O—Okay then, we'll listen to you. {NICKNAME}, let's give it a try?

choices.text: Yay, Big Sis Salsa!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, not you too!

choices.text: Perhaps a mysterious person with an equally mysterious agenda is behind this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon knows when you're just making things up! Hmph!

choices.text: Strange? I don't think it's strange at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's not sure, it's just... just looking at it makes Paimon's nose tickle!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: You know, just like asymmetry, irregularities can also be a style.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Well, the <color=#00E1FFFF>rest of the windmills are in the flower bushes</color>, except for this unsociable one... <color=#00E1FFFF>Let's place it in the bush too</color>.

talks.objective: Place the object in a suitable position

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Good, very good. It looks so much better this way!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: The points, lines, and planes are all in harmony, with every detail being executed flawlessly. Everything just looks so much more pleasing. Mm!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Dad was right when he said "There's no trash in this world that can't be saved, only resources in the wrong places."

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, thanks to your hard work, our world has taken another step in the right direction!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, we didn't do much.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that Paimon looks at it, everything sure looks better after we rearranged them. All we did was change things around a little... The sense of disarray from before is completely gone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thought you were just a kid who was full of herself... Paimon didn't expect you to actually know a lot about composition and framing.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Wha—! Aren't we buddies who battle against the evil organization together? Such little faith... I'm devastated.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's not that Paimon doesn't believe in your skills, it's just... Aww, don't be sad.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: ...Ah! Oh no!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What now?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: I nearly forgot, Mom and Dad are coming home today!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They aren't usually at home?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Yeah, because Mom and Dad are amazing. Amazing people are always very, very busy.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: I'm also very, very busy now, but I'm nowhere near as amazing. When I become a great artist, I can be as unreasonable as I want, just like Mom and Dad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What does being amazing have to do with being unreasonable?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: That's because Mom and Dad always check my homework when they're back. Even when I've finished everything! As long as I'm not sitting at my desk, they'll say...

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: "Salsa, oh Salsa, you're slacking off again. What are you going to do in the future if you play with brushes and paints all day long?"

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Even though I tell them that I've long finished my homework, they will continue nagging... But no matter how unreasonable they are, I can't get a word in because they're too brilliant.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: So I always pretend to be working really hard whenever Mom and Dad come home, even when I haven't finished my homework. Then they won't have anything to say!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Hmph! I'll say unreasonable things however I like when I become as amazing as my parents... or even better than them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This feels kinda wrong somehow...

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Oh no! I'm running late... I won't make it if I don't go off now!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: #It was so nice to meet you, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Thank you so much for helping, I gotta go home now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Be careful not to fall!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Salsa runs off with her canvas and box of drawing tools...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...She's like a little whirlwind. Children these days don't have it easy, huh? Thank goodness Paimon doesn't have homework.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, oh, Paimon, you're slacking off again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Nooo, {NICKNAME}, stop! Paimon can't hear you!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: By the way, why are there so many windmills here?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Thank goodness they aren't clockwork meka windmills, or this might be a nightmare!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: #Wow! It's {NICKNAME} and Lil' Miss Paimon! We meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi, Salsa. We were just wondering if you would be around after we saw the canvas.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We parted ways in a hurry back then... How have you been? Did you get scolded by your parents when you got home?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Hehe, I was studying at my desk when Mom and Dad came home, so they didn't have any excuse to scold me.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Although I wasn't actually studying and was just putting on an act, pretending to be studying was really tiring.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: I put up my best performance so Mom and Dad can't see through it.

choices.text: Well, you can consider acting to be a future career path.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Oh? But I've decided to become a great artist. Wait, I can become an actress who plays an artist. That doesn't sound right, though...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: ...But now that I think about it, did Mom and Dad truly not realize that I was just acting? Or are they just pretending not to know...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a complicated family relationship...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: I thought long and hard, but I still can't figure things out. I don't have enough observation skills to realize the truth...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: So I came out to sketch again. I thought that I could practice my observation skills once I found a sketching place with a beautiful view...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: But it turns out those evil green guys laid their traps here too! Ugh, this is so annoying!

choices.text: How annoying!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's terrible that they're ruining the scenery and everything... but why are you getting so worked up?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... how about rearranging it like last time? We only adjusted the item positions and everything immediately felt right.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Lil' Miss Paimon is right! We just have to adjust the positions and destroy those evil green guys' traps!

choices.text: Even if it's a trap, as long as there are treasure chests, I'll—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not even a real trap...

choices.text: I think studying hard is easier than practicing how to act...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Studying is so tiring, but acting isn't any better. Why is my life so hard?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Lil' Miss Paimon! *sobs*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello Salsa! What's wrong? You're looking really upset. Oh, there are "traps laid by the evil green guys" here too. No wonder you're in a bad mood...

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: A—Am I going to die soon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Is it that serious? It does look kinda strange, but Paimon doesn't think it's that bad. At least, it's not worse than before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no... Has Paimon's aesthetic sense been corrupted by the evil organization to the point she can't tell good from bad?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: No, no, that's not it. It's me, I got a case of "obsessive compulsive disorder."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Obsessive compulsive disorder?"

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Yeah, I've read about this disorder in books, and I can relate to the symptoms. Mom and Dad didn't really take it seriously and told me "Then you should just stop reading about it."

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: But I can't control myself. When I think about the beautiful scenery that has been destroyed by those ugly things planted by the evil organization, I'm so bothered that I can't eat or sleep at all.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: I feel really sick. My goodness, Fontaine is about to lose a great budding artist...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe you should go see a doctor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah, {NICKNAME}'s right. Paimon thinks it's best to let medical professionals handle it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon doesn't think Salsa's issue is that severe. Anyone would be upset to see a beautiful landscape destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Besides, Paimon already knows how to make you feel better! We just have to reposition those ugly things and make them part of the pretty scenery, and the problem will be solved.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a temporary solution.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #A temporary solution is still a solution! Let's get started, {NICKNAME}! With Salsa's guidance, we can definitely recreate the lovely view, right?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Hello, it's nice to see you two again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi Salsa. Oh right, about what happened last time... Paimon's sorry, are you still angry?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Hmm? Last time? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm... Paimon shouldn't have brought up a nasty topic like homework when you were in a good mood...

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Oh, that... Actually, I really forgot about my homework.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: When I got home, I realized that I hadn't finished my homework. If it weren't for you, I would have been scolded by Mom and Dad, and my teacher too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See! Told you it was for Salsa's sake! It's all thanks to Paimon's foresight, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess it's a fluke, then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's all thanks to Paimon that everything turned out well, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: It all worked out! I finished my homework so Mom and Dad are pleased, and I didn't have to try so hard to put on an act. Everyone's happy, so this is a perfect ending!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon was worried for nothing, what a huge loss.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep yep! Paimon was so worried about upsetting Salsa, she could barely enjoy her food! Who would have thought that the ever-reliable Salsa would make such a blunder?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: That's because I'm still a kid. Isn't it normal for children to be forgetful?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Even adults forget about things. Dad also forgot to turn in some paperwork before, and not only was he scolded by Mom, but also by the clerk...

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: He ended up being embarrassed for a whole week!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: It's super terrifying! I'm never going to work at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your parents work there?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's why they are always busy and often away from home. But it's better that way. If they were at home every day, I wouldn't be able to go out and sketch so often.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: I like the way it is now. My parents' work is fulfilling, and so is my work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your work? You mean homework?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Of course not. Look, there's a trap left by the evil organization here. Our job is to clear these traps, remember?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ah, the traps... Then it wouldn't be too hard since we've done the same thing many times before. {NICKNAME}, let's help Salsa again this time!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Lil' Miss Paimon... Hello there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, Salsa. Are you alright? You don't look too good...

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Do you think there's an end to time?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—Why are you asking such a deep question out of the blue?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: I'm just wondering if there will be an end to the days of fighting the evil organization.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: All I wanna do is play and chat with you while enjoying this beautiful scenery...

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: But every time we meet, ugly things will appear and get in our way... And we end up having to spend a lot of time trying to restore the view...

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Don't you have anything to say about this fate that has befallen us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can this be called fate? It just seems like a coincidence... If there's something that stands out in a place with a beautiful view, people will come to see it out of curiosity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Ugh... I'm feeling a little... tired...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let Paimon see... This is already the fifth time! No wonder you're tired...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... As long as you have an eye for beauty, there is actually amazing scenery everywhere! Why not admire the view elsewhere and ignore these ugly things?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Paimon, you're avoiding the issue! Running away is not going to solve the problem... Oh yes, since you're members of that evil organization, have you gathered any inside news?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? That's gonna be a bit difficult if it's just the two of us... But we can solve the problem right here, right away! C'mon, let's get rid of the evil trap!

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Alright then...

choices.text: Nothing matters, except for treasure chests.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're going to miss out on the scenery along the way!

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Yes, yes! Now the evil traps are all gone! I'm the best!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It sure looks a lot better now. But all we did was just change the positions of the items...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It doesn't seem difficult at all! Hmm, Paimon wonders why some people arrange things in such a strange way to begin with...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And they pick the places with beautiful scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactly! Paimon wonders if it's because they have a sense of beauty, or a lack of it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks we should get Salsa to teach the rookie members of the Adventurers' Guild the art of item arrangement.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Really? I have so much to tell those members of the evil organization! But they don't really listen to me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... Did you really go to the Adventurers' Guild to send a complaint?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Mmhmm, I talked to Katheryne, but she's really strange. All she said was "ad astra abyssosque," and she never told me which member was behind this...

choices.text: She tells me "ad astra abyssosque" too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's pretty sure she says other things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Maybe it's because you're too young, so no one really takes you seriously when you're asking questions or giving opinions.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Paimon, does Katheryne listen to you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—Yes?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: But I'm so much older than you... You're basically a kid!

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: But I'm not a child. Don't treat me as if I don't know anything! I know a lot, hmph.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, you say that, but...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: I'm a big girl. Not only do I know a lot, I have a lot of things to do! ...Ah, I have to get home.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: I really wanna play with you and Paimon a little longer, but I have to go now!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Salsa leaves with her canvas and small box...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She left in a hurry as always... We didn't even say goodbye properly this time... Paimon wonders if we'll meet her again...

choices.text: Maybe you didn't approach this correctly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right, if you suddenly talk about traps from an evil organization, Paimon's not sure if Katheryne can understand.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: I'm all cured now! This looks so much nicer.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: #You're right, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Ugly things aren't bad things. As long as we place them properly, they can become good things.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: One ugly thing down, another good thing is born. We have moved two steps forward towards a world of beauty!

choices.text: Half the effort, twice the results!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, something feels wrong with this calculation method...

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Anyway, the three of us are doing great! If we keep this up, all the ugly things will someday be gone from this world!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... Wouldn't it be difficult with just the three of us? {NICKNAME} has important things to do, and Salsa has homework, right?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: *sobs* Paimon, why do you have to say such discouraging things when everything is going well... Aren't we a team fighting for justice?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: I finally found something that made me happy, and now I'm sad again... Even you're nagging at me to do my homework... I'm going home right now!

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Bye!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Salsa leaves in a huff with her canvas and small box...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... She's gone in a flash...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Look what you've done, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Paimon didn't want her to get scolded... Paimon didn't say anything too harsh, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, anyway, Paimon should probably apologize if we ever meet Salsa again...

choices.text: I don't think we can count it like this.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: You guys are silly. Everyone knows that one plus one equals two!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's not what {NICKNAME} meant...

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: This looks so much better. This is a... reconstruction project, right? It's just like how they rebuilt the Fontaine Research Institute, and restored the ruins to its original state.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Reconstruction project?

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Yeah! Mom said the Central Laboratory was a really pretty building before it flew up into the sky, unlike now.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: But some felt that the lab in the sky is more beautiful than it was before. That's why the Fontaine Research Institute is considering launching a "Ruins Tour" for outsiders.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: Don't tell anyone, but I've been to the ruins near the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: That's when I heard about the "Ruins Tour." Two adults were arguing over whether to leave the ruins as they were.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: One of them said that if it were an ordinary building, people wouldn't be interested in it, because Fontaine has so much beautiful architecture.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: But if it were ruins, people would find it novel.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: So if they were to use "ruins" as a "selling point," they would be able to attract many visitors, and the Fontaine Research Institute's financial problems would be solved.

choices.text: Selling point...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Fontaine Research Institute is a research organization, right?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: I still think the former Fontaine Research Institute is prettier. It looks exactly like the one in the drawings.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: The lab in the sky now... looks just like a trap laid by the evil organization. Its elements are all there, but the way it's arranged is wrong, so the way it looks is wrong too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... Paimon doesn't really understand. But everything looks pretty good after we rearranged them according to your suggestions! Huh, is this what they call "artistic talent"?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Hmph, you're only saying this now? I told you, I'm a great budding artist!

choices.text: Yay! All hail the great artist!

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: I'm not there just yet... But I hope the day will come soon, hehe.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You spend a relaxing time with Salsa...\nWhen it's time to part, you say your goodbyes, and Salsa skips away merrily with her canvas and small box...

choices.text: Don't forget about us when you're famous.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: #Of course I won't! {NICKNAME} and Paimon are my buddies of justice!

choices.text: Financial problems?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Mom said that the financial problems made it even harder to apply for funding.

dialogues.speaker: Salsa
dialogues.text: And we're done! But... the evil forces are everywhere, and there're traps laid by them all over the place. There's no way the three of us will be enough...

choices.text: There's nothing we can do but to accept the reality.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmhmm, things don't always go the way we want.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Unfortunately, there aren't many people with a sense of beauty and the urge to take action like me. If there were 100 Salsas, Fontaine would surely be a more beautiful country.

choices.text: Why don't we paint the clockwork meka so that they look like Salsa?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's gonna be so scary!

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: #If there were more people like {NICKNAME} and Paimon who are willing to contribute to the cause of justice, I'm sure things would be better than they are now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Salsa, why don't you ask other people too? If you ask your parents, you might be able to submit a request to the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Wha—! Wouldn't that mean that I would have to join those evil guys? No way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Salsa, have you forgotten that {NICKNAME}'s also sort of from the Adventurers' Guild?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: You guys are different, because you're my good friends who abandoned evil ways and decided to fight for justice. But you're right, I definitely need other helpers.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: I have to find artists who have a sense of beauty and are willing to take action like me, so that we can form an alliance.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: For the future of Fontaine and the future of this land, we will stand against the evil organization that destroys the scenery.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: #Yes, that's right! {NICKNAME} and Paimon are members one and two of the "Alliance of Artists to Overthrow the Evil Organization and Protect the Future of Fontaine."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "A—Alliance of Artists to Overthrow the Evil Organization and Protect the Future of Fontaine"?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Whaddya think? It's a super-cool name, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, okay... But if we're member number one and two, then what about you, Salsa?

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: I'm the founder, so of course I'm number zero!

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Oh, the more I think about it, the more excited I am! I have so much work to do, I can't wait! The future of this world depends on us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This does sound like a job worth devoting your life to, but Paimon thinks there are a lot of things you haven't figured out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh well, never mind, as long as Salsa is happy. We're doing good things anyway.

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Mmhmm, we are fighting for a good cause! That's why I have to go find more like-minded companions right now, there's no time to waste!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is it time to say goodbye? All the best Salsa, hopefully we'll meet again!

choices.text: Goodbye, Number Zero!

response.speaker: Salsa
response.text: Bye bye, Number One and Two! I hope to see you again in a more beautiful Fontaine!

choices.text: Good luck Salsa, you got this.
I think that'll end up becoming another evil trap...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: One hundred Salsas... Paimon's head hurts just thinking about a hundred Salsas calling Paimon "Lil' Miss"...

choices.text: Let's destroy all of this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're trying to make the trap disappear by rearranging things, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...You're not really going to destroy them all, are you?
